prompts.iris: Precise repair of this isolated iris layer for Live2D. Preserve the ORIGINAL muted medium periwinkle blue iris palette and smooth darker soft round pupil in the center, and original brighter curved blue reflection across lower iris. Remove the oversized dark blue crescent cap above the oval and the separate cyan crescent below it, all white edge debris and holes. Reconstruct a COMPLETE clean vertical oval with smooth dark navy rim. Remove the damaged white circular top highlight hole by filling it with matching iris blue. Keep the lower circular cyan highlight in the same location and same size, repair its dark damaged top. Do not add white highlights (they are separate layers), do not enlarge or darken the center pupil, do not make the eye flat, do not add neon glow or saturated royal blue. Transparent background. Match underlying original iris shape width:height about 0.9. Only one iris.
prompts.upperLine: Repair this isolated upper anime eyelash line. Keep its original overall shallow arched shape and dark near-black navy color. Remove all short horizontal rectangular spikes and blocks above the arch, detached fragments on the far left and blue scraps below. Smooth top and bottom edges. A single clean thick curved tapering upper lash, softly rounded left end with just the original outward lash extension, right end tapering to a point. Match original main arch width, thickness, curvature; no added lashes, iris, skin or white eye. Transparent background. Do not make the line bigger or rounder.
prompts.eyeWhite: Create a single SOLID OPAQUE filled white horizontal oval shape for a cartoon eye sclera. It must be an entirely filled flat light ivory white disk (#fffdf9), no hole, no transparency inside the oval, no outline, no shadow, no gradients, no pupil, no iris. Smooth ellipse silhouette width 1.35 times height. Background transparent ONLY OUTSIDE the disk. This is a flat 2D solid white cutout, not a ring or donut. All interior pixels fully opaque white.
